claims: The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
Ryan Coogler won his first career Oscar for Best Original Screenplay for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners is a Southern Gothic vampire thriller.
Sinners received 16 total nominations at the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners' 16 nominations set a new record surpassing the previous record of 14 nominations.
Ryan Coogler won Best Original Screenplay for Sinners at the 2026 Oscars.
Ryan Coogler was nominated for Best Director for Sinners.
Ryan Coogler was nominated for Best Picture as producer for Sinners.
Ryan Coogler is the second Black American filmmaker to win the Best Original Screenplay award.
In his acceptance speech, Ryan Coogler thanked his cast and crew.
In his acceptance speech, Ryan Coogler thanked his wife Zinzi Evans.
In his acceptance speech, Ryan Coogler thanked his children.
In his acceptance speech, Ryan Coogler asked his team to stand and be recognized.
In his acceptance speech, Ryan Coogler told his team they were all winners
